included: mel/embedding/head per-frame cost on target at the 80 ms streaming cadence
embedding NBG import/quantize/export logs, sizes, and hashes

any Bonsai decode objective or current-best claim

chain_costs_a55.note: An earlier end-to-end loop benchmark reported a misleading 12.8 ms/frame because warm-up frames without stage runs diluted the average; the per-stage table is the honest number.
